items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And I told you, I saw Ike's wife, told me she's still living in the same place.

ctx.x: He said, I saw Ike's wife. Is he living? Yeah, she told me, yeah, Ike, listen. He's sickly, he's sickly. You remember? Wait, I tell you what happened. I went into Trimmy, to get something. I went to Trimmy to buy something for you. And I told you, I saw Ike's wife, told me she's still living in the same place. And I was sitting out on the step about a couple of weeks ago, she passed out there. Yeah, I think he's sick. I think he's sick. But she told me, no, Ike ain't dead. Ike ain't just a big and fat kid. I…
I don't know him at all. I must see him very soon, but I don't, I thought he was still living. I didn't know. I hope so. I didn't know, I hope so myself.
